articles.title_en: Designing contests between heterogeneous contestants: An experimental study of tie-breaks and bid-caps in all-pay auctions
articles.title_cn: 设计异质参赛者之间的竞赛：全支付拍卖中平局决胜与出价上限的实验研究
articles.abstract_en: A well-known theoretical result in the contest literature is that greater heterogeneity decreases investments of contestants because of the “discouragement effect.” Levelling the playing field by favouring weaker contestants through strict bid-caps and favourable tie-breaking rules can reduce discouragement and increase the designer's revenue. We test these predictions in a laboratory experiment. Our data confirm that placing bid-caps and using favourable tie-breaking rules significantly diminishes discouragement of weaker contestants. However, its impact on revenues is muted by the fact that the encouragement of weaker contestants is offset by stronger contestants competing less aggressively, even when not predicted by theory. We discuss deviations from the Nash predictions in light of different behavioural approaches.
articles.abstract_cn: 竞赛文献中一个著名的理论结果是，更大的异质性会因“沮丧效应”而减少参赛者的投资。通过严格的出价上限和有利的平局决胜规则来偏袒较弱参赛者，可以平竞争环境，减少沮丧并增加设计者的收入。我们在实验室实验中检验了这些预测。我们的数据证实，设置出价上限和使用有利的平局决胜规则显著减轻了较弱参赛者的沮丧。然而，其对收入的影响因较弱参赛者的激励被较强参赛者不那么激进的竞争所抵消而减弱，即使这在理论上并未被预测。我们结合不同的行为方法讨论了与纳什预测的偏差。

articles.title_en: Macroprudential regulation and leakage to the shadow banking sector
articles.title_cn: 宏观审慎监管与向影子银行部门的溢出
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of macroprudential commercial bank regulation on the shadow banking sector via an estimated New Keynesian DSGE model that differentiates between monopolistically competitive commercial banks and shadow banks that rely on funding in a perfectly competitive market for investments. We find that tighter capital requirements on commercial banks increase shadow bank lending, which may have adverse financial stability effects. Coordinating macroprudential tightening with monetary easing can limit this leakage mechanism, while overall maintaining a reduction in aggregate lending. In a counterfactual analysis we compare how macroprudential policy implemented before the 2008 financial crisis would have affected business and lending cycles.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一个估计的新凯恩斯主义DSGE模型研究宏观审慎商业银行监管对影子银行部门的影响，该模型区分了垄断竞争的商业银行和依赖在完全竞争的投资市场中融资的影子银行。我们发现，对商业银行更严格的资本要求会增加影子银行的贷款，这可能对金融稳定产生不利影响。将宏观审慎收紧与货币宽松相协调可以限制这种溢出机制，同时总体上保持总贷款的减少。在反事实分析中，我们比较了在2008金融危机前实施的宏观审慎政策将如何影响商业和贷款周期。

articles.title_en: Talent discovery, layoff risk and unemployment insurance
articles.title_cn: 人才发现、裁员风险与失业保险
articles.abstract_en: In talent-intensive jobs, workers’ quality is revealed by their performance. This enhances productivity and earnings, but also increases layoff risk. We show that, if firms compete for talent, they cannot insure workers against this risk, so that the more risk-averse workers will choose less quality-revealing jobs. This lowers expected productivity and salaries. Our model predicts that public unemployment insurance corrects this inefficiency, increasing employment in talent-sensitive industries. This prediction is consistent with the distribution of U.S. employment across occupations and states. Unemployment insurance dominates legal restrictions on firms’ dismissals, which penalize more talent-sensitive firms and thus depress expected productivity.
articles.abstract_cn: 在人才密集型工作中，工人的质量通过其表现得以揭示。这提高了生产率和收入，但也增加了裁员风险。我们表明，如果企业竞争人才，它们无法为工人提供针对这种风险的保险，因此更厌恶风险的工人会选择质量揭示程度较低的工作。这降低了预期生产率和工资。我们的模型预测，公共失业保险能够纠正这种低效率，增加人才敏感行业的就业。这一预测与美国各职业和各州的就业分布一致。失业保险优于对企业解雇行为的法律限制，后者会惩罚人才敏感型企业，从而压低预期生产率。

articles.title_en: Gauging the effects of the German COVID-19 fiscal stimulus package
articles.title_cn: 评估德国COVID-19财政刺激计划的效果
articles.abstract_en: We simulate the fiscal stimulus package set up by the German government to alleviate the costs of the COVID-19 pandemic in a dynamic New Keynesian multi-sector general equilibrium model. We find that, cumulated over 2020–2022, output losses relative to steady state can be reduced by more than 6 PP. On average, welfare costs of the pandemic can be mitigated by 11%, or even by 33% for liquidity-constrained households. The long-run present value multiplier of the package amounts to 0.5. Consumption tax cuts and transfers to households primarily stabilize private consumption, and subsidies prevent firm defaults. The most cost-effective measure is an increase in productivity-enhancing public investment. However, it only fully materializes in the medium to long-term. Relative to the respective pandemic impact, some sectors such as the energy and the manufacturing sector benefit above average from the fiscal package, while the effect for some services sectors turns out to be below average.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个动态新凯恩斯主义多部门一般均衡模型中模拟了德国政府为缓解COVID-19疫情成本而设立的财政刺激计划。我们发现，累计在2020-2022年，相对于稳态的产出损失可以减少超过6个百分点。平均而言，疫情的福利成本可以减轻11%，对于流动性受限的家庭甚至可减轻33%。该计划的长期现值乘数为0.5。消费税削减和对家庭的转移支付主要稳定了私人消费，而补贴则防止了企业违约。最具成本效益的措施是增加提高生产率的基础设施投资。然而，这种效果只有在中期到长期才能完全显现。相对于各自的疫情冲击，能源和制造业等一些部门从财政计划中受益高于平均水平，而一些服务部门的效果则低于平均水平。

articles.title_en: Banks, nonbanks, and business cycles
articles.title_cn: 银行、非银行金融机构与商业周期
articles.abstract_en: European macroeconomic and financial aggregates move in lockstep over the business cycle. We develop a model in which a single risk premium shock triggers these comovements. The key feature is a financial sector where traditional banks transfer part of their risky loan portfolio to nonbank institutions. We fit the model to euro area data and find that risk premium shocks are the main driver of business and financial cycles over the past two decades.
articles.abstract_cn: 欧洲宏观经济和金融总量在商业周期中同步变动。我们构建了一个模型，其中单一的风险溢价冲击引发了这些联动。关键特征在于金融部门，传统银行将其部分风险贷款组合转移给非银行机构。我们将模型拟合至欧元区数据，发现风险溢价冲击是过去二十年商业和金融周期的主要驱动因素。

articles.title_en: Formation of the legacy of slavery: Evidence from the US South
articles.title_cn: 奴隶制遗产的形成：来自美国南部的证据
articles.abstract_en: Where slavery had been more prevalent, African Americans accumulated human capital at a slower rate after the Civil War. However, the shadow of slavery emerged after Reconstruction. This study suggests a mechanism by which the historical prevalence of slavery led to selective application of post-Reconstruction labor policies, which in turn reduced the effectiveness of Black human capital. Supporting this hypothesis, evidence indicates a decline in the return to Black literacy after Reconstruction with historical slave concentration. To identify the roles of post-Reconstruction policies, we examine the consequences of anti-enticement laws, which embodied the essence of labor polices after Reconstruction. Border-county analyses show that the laws were applied more effectively in slave-intensive counties, which reinforced racial hierarchy among workers and thus reduced the return to Black literacy. Evidence from the return to education echoes the findings from literacy.
articles.abstract_cn: 在奴隶制更为盛行的地区，内战后非裔美国人的人力资本积累速度较慢。然而，奴隶制的阴影在重建时期之后才显现。本研究提出了一种机制，即历史上奴隶制的盛行导致了重建后劳动政策的选择性应用，进而降低了黑人人力资本的有效性。支持这一假设的证据表明，重建后黑人识字率的回报随着历史奴隶集中度而下降。为了识别重建后政策的作用，我们考察了反诱骗法的影响，这些法律体现了重建后劳动政策的精髓。边境县分析显示，这些法律在奴隶密集型县中应用更为有效，这强化了工人之间的种族等级制度，从而降低了黑人识字率的回报。来自教育回报的证据与识字率的发现相呼应。

articles.title_en: Adoption of a new payment method: Experimental evidence
articles.title_cn: 新支付方式的采用：实验证据
articles.abstract_en: We develop a framework for studying the introduction of a new payment method in a controlled laboratory environment, where consumers (buyers) and merchants (sellers) can learn to coordinate their adoption decisions over time. The underlying game exhibits network adoption effects as emphasized by the theoretical literature. We elicit players’ beliefs about the adoption decisions of the other side of the market so that we can directly test for network effects. We investigate how the additional fixed cost of adopting the new payment method, relative to its savings on per transaction costs, affects merchant’s decisions to adopt the new payment method and how that in turn affects buyer’s adoption decisions. We find that a low fixed cost favors quick adoption of the new payment method by all participants, while for a sufficiently high fixed cost, merchants gradually learn to reject the new payment method. We also find strong evidence of network effects and that the fixed costs are important for the strong response of seller acceptance decisions to buyer adoption decisions. An evolutionary learning model provides a good characterization of the dynamic adjustment paths found in our experimental data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个框架，用于在受控实验室环境中研究新支付方式的引入，其中消费者（买方）和商家（卖方）可以学习随时间协调其采用决策。基础博弈表现出理论文献所强调的网络采用效应。我们引出参与者对市场另一方采用决策的信念，以便直接检验网络效应。我们调查了采用新支付方式的额外固定成本相对于其在每笔交易成本上的节省如何影响商家采用新支付方式的决策，以及这又如何影响买方的采用决策。我们发现，低固定成本有利于所有参与者快速采用新支付方式，而当固定成本足够高时，商家逐渐学会拒绝新支付方式。我们还发现了网络效应的有力证据，并且固定成本对于卖方接受决策对买方采用决策的强烈反应至关重要。一个进化学习模型很好地刻画了我们的实验数据中发现的动态调整路径。

articles.title_en: Women’s education, fertility and children’ health during a gender equalization process: Evidence from a child labor reform in Spain
articles.title_cn: 性别平等化进程中的女性教育、生育与儿童健康：来自西班牙童工改革的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of women’s education on fertility and children’s health during a period of gender equalization and women’s greater access to economic opportunities. In 1980, Spain raised the minimum working age from 14 to 16, while the compulsory education age remained at 14. This reform changed the within-cohort incentives to remain in the educational system. Using a difference-in-differences approach, we find that the reform delayed fertility but did not impact the completed fertility of affected women. We also show that the reform was detrimental to the health of the children of affected mothers at delivery. We document two channels for this adverse effect: the postponement in the entrance of motherhood and the deterioration of mothers’ health habits (such as smoking and drinking). However, in the medium run, these more educated mothers reverse the adverse health shocks at birth through maternal vigilance and investment in their children’s health habits.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在性别平等化和女性获得更多经济机会的时期，女性教育对生育和儿童健康的影响。1980年，西班牙将最低工作年龄从14岁提高到16岁，而义务教育年龄仍为14岁。这项改革改变了同队列内留在教育系统的激励。使用双重差分方法，我们发现改革推迟了生育，但并未影响受影响女性的完成生育率。我们还表明，改革对受影响母亲分娩时儿童的健康产生了不利影响。我们记录了这种不利影响的两个渠道：进入母亲角色的推迟和母亲健康习惯（如吸烟和饮酒）的恶化。然而，在中期，这些受教育程度更高的母亲通过母亲的警惕性和对子女健康习惯的投资，逆转了出生时的不利健康冲击。

articles.title_en: The effects of uncertainty shocks: Implications of wealth inequality
articles.title_cn: 不确定性冲击的影响：财富不平等的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether and how the effects of time-varying macroeconomic uncertainty depend on the distribution of wealth. I show that increases in wealth inequality amplify the responses to uncertainty shocks. Using deciles of the distribution of wealth along with a series of macroeconomic volatility for the United States, I find that consumption growth falls by approximately 0.25 percentage points more in response to a one standard deviation uncertainty shock when wealth inequality is high relative to when it is low. In order to understand the nonlinear effects of uncertainty on consumption growth, I consider a two-agent New Keynesian model. I calibrate this simple model to qualitatively match the empirical responses of consumption growth to a one standard deviation uncertainty shock and show that nominal rigidities are key to magnifying the effects of uncertainty under high wealth inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了时变宏观经济不确定性的影响是否以及如何取决于财富分配。我表明，财富不平等的加剧放大了对不确定性冲击的反应。利用美国财富分配十分位数以及一系列宏观经济波动性数据，我发现，当财富不平等程度较高时，消费增长对一标准差不确定性冲击的反应比不平等程度较低时大约多下降0.25个百分点。为了理解不确定性对消费增长的非线性影响，我考虑了一个双主体新凯恩斯模型。我将这个简单模型校准为定性地匹配消费增长对一标准差不确定性冲击的经验反应，并表明名义刚性是在高财富不平等下放大不确定性影响的关键。

articles.title_en: Reducing the gender gap in early learning: Evidence from a field experiment in Norwegian preschools
articles.title_cn: 缩小早期学习中的性别差距：挪威幼儿园的一项实地实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Substantial gender differences in key academic skills appear even before children start formal schooling. Although increasing investments in early-childhood programs is motivated by efforts to promote equality of opportunity in education, program attendance seems to have less effect on boys. In this field experiment, we investigate whether a more structured curriculum can help preschools reduce the gender gap in early learning. While girls have higher skills at baseline, we find that the intervention primarily benefits boys, thereby reducing the gender skill gap, with effects persisting into formal schooling.
articles.abstract_cn: 即使在儿童开始正式学校教育之前，关键学术技能方面就出现了显著的性别差异。尽管增加对早期儿童项目的投资是出于促进教育机会平等的动机，但项目参与似乎对男孩的影响较小。在这项实地实验中，我们调查了更结构化的课程是否有助于幼儿园缩小早期学习中的性别差距。虽然女孩在基线时技能较高，但我们发现干预措施主要惠及男孩，从而缩小了性别技能差距，且这种影响持续到正式学校教育阶段。

articles.title_en: Diamond–Dybvig and beyond: On the instability of banking
articles.title_cn: 戴蒙德-迪布维格及其超越：论银行业的不稳定性
articles.abstract_en: Are financial intermediaries – in particular, banks – inherently unstable or fragile, and if so, why? We address this theoretically by analyzing whether model economies with financial intermediation are more prone than those without it to multiple, cyclic, or stochastic equilibria. Several formalizations are considered: Insurance-based banking; models with reputational considerations; those with fixed costs and delegated investment; and those where bank liabilities serve as payment instruments. Importantly for the issue at hand, in each case banking arrangements arise endogenously. While the economics and mathematics differ across specifications, they all predict that financial intermediation engenders instability in a precise sense.
articles.abstract_cn: 金融中介机构——尤其是银行——是否天生不稳定或脆弱，如果是，原因何在？我们通过分析具有金融中介的模型经济体是否比没有金融中介的经济体更容易出现多重均衡、周期均衡或随机均衡，从理论上解决这一问题。我们考虑了多种形式化：基于保险的银行业；具有声誉考虑的模型；具有固定成本和委托投资的模型；以及银行负债作为支付工具的模型。对于所讨论的问题重要的是，在每种情况下，银行业安排都是内生出现的。尽管不同设定下的经济学和数学有所不同，但它们都预测金融中介在精确意义上会产生不稳定性。

articles.title_en: Biased expectations
articles.title_cn: 有偏预期
articles.abstract_en: We propose two novel measures of the cognitive bias of over-optimism, ex ante optimism and ex post optimism, using a quarterly consumer expectations survey. We demonstrate the micro-foundations of the proposed measures and show empirically that excessive consumer optimism about future family finances impacts the real economy. Ex ante, excessive optimism compels consumers to save less and borrow more, putting upward pressure on consumption growth. Ex post, when family finances improve persistently less than expected, consumers cut back on credit and save more which puts downward pressure on consumption growth. This saving and borrowing channel of the optimism bias is robust to consumer age.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用季度消费者预期调查，提出了过度乐观这一认知偏差的两种新度量：事前乐观和事后乐观。我们展示了所提出度量的微观基础，并实证表明，消费者对未来家庭财务的过度乐观会影响实体经济。事前，过度乐观促使消费者减少储蓄、增加借贷，对消费增长产生上行压力。事后，当家庭财务状况的改善持续低于预期时，消费者会减少信贷并增加储蓄，这对消费增长产生下行压力。这种乐观偏差的储蓄和借贷渠道在不同年龄的消费者中均稳健存在。

articles.title_en: The political economy of lighthouses in antebellum America
articles.title_cn: 美国内战前灯塔的政治经济学
articles.abstract_en: The study of the lighthouse features prominently in debates over the private provision of public services. However, little attention has been devoted to how lighthouse systems operated once governments took charge of its production. We exploit the fact that Antebellum America came close to the ideal textbook solution to providing public goods and we assess how the government allocated lighthouses before the Civil War. We find some evidence that the lighthouses were built according to commercial needs. However, we discover stronger evidence that political considerations played a role in selecting where lighthouses would be built.
articles.abstract_cn: 灯塔的研究在关于公共服务私人提供的辩论中占有重要地位。然而，一旦政府接管了灯塔的生产，关于灯塔系统如何运作的关注却很少。我们利用美国内战前接近教科书式公共物品提供理想解决方案的事实，评估了政府在南北战争前如何分配灯塔。我们发现一些证据表明，灯塔是根据商业需求建造的。然而，我们发现了更有力的证据表明，政治考量在选择灯塔建造地点方面发挥了作用。

articles.title_en: Long-term inflation expectations and monetary policy in the euro area before the pandemic
articles.title_cn: 疫情前欧元区的长期通胀预期与货币政策
articles.abstract_en: Survey-based long-term inflation expectations in the euro area reached historically low levels at the end of 2019. A structural VAR analysis shows that the decline in long-term expectations exerted a downward pressure on inflation during the 2013–14 disinflation and in 2019. Counterfactual simulations show that the decrease in inflation would have been larger and output would have declined had the European Central Bank not responded to the fall in expectations. A small New Keynesian model, in which the private sector's estimate of the inflation target varies with inflation, can rationalise the VAR evidence.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于调查的欧元区长期通胀预期在2019年底达到历史低位。结构VAR分析显示，长期预期的下降在2013-14年通缩期间和2019年对通胀产生了下行压力。反事实模拟表明，如果欧洲央行未对预期下降作出反应，通胀下降幅度会更大，产出会下降。一个小型新凯恩斯模型，其中私人部门对通胀目标的估计随通胀变化，可以合理化VAR证据。

articles.title_en: Sexual identity, gender, and anticipated discrimination in prosocial behavior
articles.title_cn: 性身份、性别与亲社会行为中的预期歧视
articles.abstract_en: We study whether individuals strategically mask signals about their affinity with the LGBTQ+ community in response to anticipated discrimination in prosocial behavior. We use a sharing (dictator) game in an online experiment where recipients are given the opportunity to signal their LGBTQ+ affinity. Decision-makers, upon observing these signals, decide how much of their endowment to share with their matched recipients. Overall, there is a decrease (although statistically insignificant) in the proportions of recipients who signal their affinity with the LGBTQ+ community when they are informed that these signals will be revealed to decision-makers. Importantly, we find a gender difference: women are more likely to hide such signals given information about how the signals will be used. Auxiliary analysis suggests that this gender difference is likely due to women’s higher propensity to anticipate discrimination. Moreover, we find that decision-makers do not differ in their treatment of individuals based on signals of their LGBTQ+ affinity. However, the intersection between decision-makers’ perceptions of these signals, and both their political stance on social issues and their views about LGBTQ+ rights, matter in shaping their sharing behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究个体是否会策略性地掩盖其与LGBTQ+群体亲和性的信号，以应对亲社会行为中的预期歧视。我们在在线实验中采用分享（独裁者）博弈，其中接受者有机会发出其LGBTQ+亲和性的信号。决策者在观察到这些信号后，决定将其禀赋中的多少分享给匹配的接受者。总体而言，当接受者被告知这些信号将向决策者披露时，发出LGBTQ+亲和性信号的接受者比例有所下降（尽管在统计上不显著）。重要的是，我们发现存在性别差异：在获知信号将如何被使用的情况下，女性更可能隐藏此类信号。辅助分析表明，这种性别差异可能源于女性更高的预期歧视倾向。此外，我们发现决策者对待个体的方式并不因其LGBTQ+亲和性信号而有所不同。然而，决策者对这些信号的感知，以及他们在社会问题上的政治立场和对LGBTQ+权利的看法，共同影响了他们的分享行为。

articles.title_en: Energy shortages and aggregate demand: Output loss and unequal burden from HANK
articles.title_cn: 能源短缺与总需求：来自HANK的产出损失与不平等负担
articles.abstract_en: I study the effects of a reduction in energy supply using a quantitative Heterogeneous Agents New Keynesian (HANK) model with energy consumption by households and firms. I find that changes in aggregate demand due to an increase in energy prices and labor market adjustments amplify the macroeconomic effects of the energy shock, but these effects remain manageable. In the model a 10% reduction in the energy supply leads to a Gross National Income (GNI) loss in range between 0.8% and 2%. The economic burden is highly nonlinear across the income distribution: most households face similar and relatively contained costs, while low-income households bear the heaviest burden. I show that monetary and fiscal policy can mitigate the economic costs and the unequal effects of energy shortages.
articles.abstract_cn: 我使用一个包含家庭和企业能源消费的定量异质性代理人新凯恩斯（HANK）模型，研究了能源供应减少的影响。我发现，由于能源价格上涨和劳动力市场调整引起的总需求变化放大了能源冲击的宏观经济效应，但这些效应仍然可控。在模型中，能源供应减少10%会导致国民总收入（GNI）损失在0.8%至2%之间。经济负担在收入分配中高度非线性：大多数家庭面临相似且相对有限的成本，而低收入家庭承担最沉重的负担。我表明，货币政策和财政政策可以缓解能源短缺的经济成本和不平等影响。

articles.title_en: Revisiting the New Keynesian policy paradoxes under QE
articles.title_cn: 重新审视量化宽松下的新凯恩斯政策悖论
articles.abstract_en: Standard New Keynesian models deliver puzzling results at the effective lower bound of short-term interest rates: greater price flexibility amplifies the fall in the output gap in response to adverse demand shocks; labour tax cuts are contractionary; the multiplier of wasteful government spending is large. These outcomes stem from a failure to characterise monetary policy correctly. Both analytically and numerically, we show that allowing the central bank to respond to inflation with quantitative easing can resolve all these paradoxes. In quantitative terms, mild adjustments to the central bank’s balance sheet are sufficient to obtain results more in line with conventional wisdom.
articles.abstract_cn: 标准的新凯恩斯模型在短期利率有效下限处产生了令人困惑的结果：更大的价格灵活性放大了不利需求冲击下产出缺口的下降；劳动税削减是紧缩性的；浪费性政府支出的乘数很大。这些结果源于未能正确描述货币政策。通过分析和数值方法，我们表明允许中央银行通过量化宽松对通胀作出反应可以解决所有这些悖论。在数量上，对中央银行资产负债表的温和调整就足以获得更符合传统智慧的结果。

articles.title_en: Heterogeneous expectations, forecast accuracy and firms’ credit demand
articles.title_cn: 异质性预期、预测准确性与企业信贷需求
articles.abstract_en: Firm heterogeneity in formulating expectations constitutes a source of friction for the credit market. An expected improvement of credit conditions in the future may slacken current credit demand. Using a panel of European firms in the period 2010–2019, I find that better expectations on future (six-month) access to credit reduce the probability of a firm to apply for bank loans by 3 percent. Results also suggest that access to credit expectations are adaptive. Although firms fail 43 percent of their access to credit forecasts, they adjust their expectations learning from previous forecast errors.
articles.abstract_cn: 企业在形成预期时的异质性构成了信贷市场摩擦的一个来源。对未来信贷条件的预期改善可能会削弱当前的信贷需求。利用2010-2019年期间欧洲企业的面板数据，我发现对未来（六个月）信贷获取的更好预期会使企业申请银行贷款的概率降低3%。结果还表明，信贷获取预期是适应性的。尽管企业在其信贷获取预测中有43%的失败率，但它们会从先前的预测错误中学习来调整其预期。

articles.title_en: Tuition fees and educational attainment
articles.title_cn: 学费与教育成就
articles.abstract_en: Following a landmark court ruling in 2005, more than half of Germany’s universities started charging tuition fees, which were later abolished in a staggered manner. We exploit the fact that even students who were already enrolled had to start paying fees. We show that fees increase study effort and degree completion among these students. However, fees also decrease first-time university enrollment among high school graduates. Combining this enrollment impact with the effect on completion, we find that fees around the zero-price margin have only little effect on overall educational attainment. We conclude by discussing policies targeting the separate effect margins of fees and caution against a general abolition.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2005年一项具有里程碑意义的法院裁决之后，德国超过一半的大学开始收取学费，这些费用后来以交错的方式被废除。我们利用了一个事实，即即使是已经入学的学生也必须开始支付费用。我们表明，费用增加了这些学生的学业努力和学位完成率。然而，费用也降低了高中毕业生首次大学入学的比例。将这一入学影响与对完成率的影响相结合，我们发现，在零价格边际附近的费用对整体教育成就的影响很小。最后，我们讨论了针对费用不同影响边际的政策，并警告不要普遍废除学费。

articles.title_en: Costly multi-unit search
articles.title_cn: 昂贵的多单位搜索
articles.abstract_en: We formulate and solve a costly multi-unit search problem for the optimal selling of a stock of goods. Our showcase application is an inventory liquidation problem with holding costs, such as warehousing, salaries or floor planning. A seller faces a stream of buyers periodically arriving with random capped demands. At each decision point, he decides how to price each unit and also whether to stop searching or not. We set this as a dynamic programming problem and solve it inductively by characterizing optimal search rules and reservation prices. Our inductive logic does not rely in the use of the first order conditions for optimal pricing and optimal search decisions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建并解决了一个昂贵的多单位搜索问题，用于商品库存的最优销售。我们的展示应用是一个带有持有成本（如仓储、工资或地板规划）的库存清算问题。卖方面临着一系列定期到达的买家，这些买家具有随机的有上限需求。在每个决策点，他决定如何为每个单位定价，以及是否停止搜索。我们将其设定为一个动态规划问题，并通过刻画最优搜索规则和保留价格来归纳地解决它。我们的归纳逻辑不依赖于最优定价和最优搜索决策的一阶条件。

articles.title_en: Robust trade policy to offset foreign market power
articles.title_cn: 稳健的贸易政策以抵消外国市场势力
articles.abstract_en: While it is well known that trade policy can be used to counter foreign firm market power, it suffers from a lack of robustness over what form it should take. If the import demand function has a certain curvature then a tariff will improve importer welfare while an import subsidy will lower it. However, the opposite holds if the import demand function has a different shape. Picking the right option is made even more difficult as there is little hope of confidently identifying the curvature of import demand. This paper demonstrates that moving beyond the either/or dichotomy and using a combination of an ad valorem tariff and a specific import subsidy can completely offset a foreign firm’s market power. This policy is not subject to the information constraints that undermine the single instrument choice, making it more robust. Combining it with a simple fiscal neutrality constraint delivers an efficient outcome, which is also robust to; country size; whether the market power is in the hands of a foreign exporter (monopoly) or importer (monopsony); and, more generally, the nature of conduct when more than one foreign firm has market power (oligopoly/oligopsony).
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管众所周知，贸易政策可用于对抗外国企业的市场势力，但其应采取何种形式却缺乏稳健性。如果进口需求函数具有某种曲率，那么关税将改善进口国福利，而进口补贴则会降低福利。然而，如果进口需求函数具有不同形状，则情况相反。由于几乎没有希望可靠地识别进口需求的曲率，选择正确的选项变得更加困难。本文证明，超越非此即彼的二分法，采用从价关税与特定进口补贴的组合，可以完全抵消外国企业的市场势力。该政策不受削弱单一工具选择的信息约束影响，因此更具稳健性。将其与简单的财政中性约束相结合，可实现有效结果，并且该结果对以下方面也具有稳健性：国家规模；市场势力掌握在外国出口商（垄断）还是进口商（买方垄断）手中；以及更一般地，当多个外国企业拥有市场势力（寡头垄断/寡头买方垄断）时的行为性质。

articles.title_en: Green technology policies versus carbon pricing: An intergenerational perspective
articles.title_cn: 绿色技术政策与碳定价：代际视角
articles.abstract_en: Technology policy is the most widespread form of climate policy and is often preferred over seemingly efficient carbon pricing. We propose a new explanation for this observation: gains that predominantly accrue to households with large capital assets and that influence majority decisions in favor of technology policy. We study climate policy choices in an overlapping generations model with heterogeneous energy technologies and distortionary income taxation. Compared to carbon pricing, green technology policy leads to a pronounced capital subsidy effect that benefits most of the current generations but burdens future generations. Based on majority voting which disregards future generations, green technology policies are favored over a carbon tax. Smart “polluter-pays” financing of green technology policies enables obtaining the support of current generations while realizing efficiency gains for future generations.
articles.abstract_cn: 技术政策是气候政策最普遍的形式，且通常优于看似高效的碳定价。我们对此现象提出一种新的解释：收益主要归于拥有大量资本资产的家庭，并影响多数决策偏向技术政策。我们在一个具有异质性能源技术和扭曲性所得税的重叠世代模型中研究气候政策选择。与碳定价相比，绿色技术政策产生显著的资本补贴效应，惠及当前大多数世代，但加重未来世代的负担。基于忽视未来世代的多数投票，绿色技术政策优于碳税。绿色技术政策的明智“污染者付费”融资方式，能够在实现未来世代效率收益的同时，获得当前世代的支持。

articles.title_en: Uncertainty shocks in emerging economies: A global to local approach for identification
articles.title_cn: 新兴经济体的不确定性冲击：一种从全球到局部的识别方法
articles.abstract_en: The paper investigates the effects of uncertainty shocks in emerging economies (EMEs). I construct novel measures of uncertainty for fifteen small EMEs and to address endogeneity I instrument them with fluctuations in global uncertainty. My results show that uncertainty shocks have substantial contractionary effects on GDP, stock prices and local currencies and the recessionary effect is much stronger in EMEs compared to advanced economies (AEs). I also estimate a negative co-movement between prices and output which triggers a delayed monetary tightening in correspondence to the inflationary peak. Counterfactual scenarios reveal that in the absence of uncertainty shocks, the fall in GDP recorded in EMEs during the 2008–2009 crisis would have been attenuated by around 2%.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了不确定性冲击对新兴经济体（EMEs）的影响。我为十五个小型新兴经济体构建了新的不确定性度量，并为了解决内生性问题，使用全球不确定性的波动作为工具变量。我的结果表明，不确定性冲击对GDP、股票价格和本币汇率具有显著的紧缩效应，且与发达经济体（AEs）相比，新兴经济体的衰退效应更为强烈。我还估计了价格与产出之间的负向联动，这引发了在通胀峰值对应的延迟货币紧缩。反事实情景显示，在没有不确定性冲击的情况下，2008-2009年危机期间新兴经济体记录的GDP下降幅度将减少约2%。

articles.title_en: The maturity composition of government debt: A comprehensive database
articles.title_cn: 政府债务的期限结构：一个综合数据库
articles.abstract_en: We present a novel dataset which covers all central government debt issued by twenty OECD economies over the last quarter century and describe common features of debt management and the composition of debt across time and countries. Just like debt levels, debt maturity has substantially increased over this sample period. Despite this long term positive co-movement, there is a clear short term tendency for debt maturity to shorten as debt increases. Maturity is actively reshuffled, even at constant levels of debt. The majority of fluctuations in maturity are consistent with cost-minimization.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个新颖的数据集，涵盖了二十个OECD经济体在过去四分之一世纪中发行的所有中央政府债务，并描述了债务管理的共同特征以及债务在不同时间和国家间的构成。与债务水平一样，债务期限在该样本期间也大幅增加。尽管存在这种长期的正向共同运动，但短期内存在明显的趋势，即随着债务增加，债务期限缩短。即使在债务水平不变的情况下，期限也会被积极调整。期限波动的大部分与成本最小化一致。

articles.title_en: Private sector debt overhang and government spending multipliers: Not all debts are alike
articles.title_cn: 私人部门债务积压与政府支出乘数：并非所有债务都一样
articles.abstract_en: This study empirically examines whether government spending multipliers vary depending on the level of debt in the private sector by estimating an interacted panel vector autoregressive model (IPVAR) with unbalanced panel data from 29 OECD countries. Results reveal that (i) government spending multipliers become larger in private debt overhang; (ii) and not all debts are alike: empirical evidence on the larger multipliers in household debt overhang are mixed, while the larger multipliers in firm debt overhang are clear; (iii) in firm debt overhang, positive government spending strongly crowds in both private consumption and investment compared comparing with low firm debt periods, and the multipliers are larger than one; and (iv) in household debt overhang, those crowding-in effects, particularly the effects on private consumption, are not as strong. I investigate various private debt-dependent transmission channels of government spending, including the labor and financial markets. Differences in the behavior of the labor market and investment decision across firm debt overhang and household debt overhang may be important for understanding the empirical results.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究通过估计一个交互面板向量自回归模型（IPVAR），使用来自29个OECD国家的不平衡面板数据，实证检验政府支出乘数是否随私人部门债务水平而变化。结果表明：（i）在私人债务积压情况下，政府支出乘数变大；（ii）并非所有债务都一样：关于家庭债务积压中乘数变大的经验证据不一，而企业债务积压中乘数变大的证据则明确；（iii）在企业债务积压情况下，与低企业债务时期相比，积极的政府支出强烈挤入私人消费和投资，且乘数大于一；（iv）在家庭债务积压情况下，这些挤入效应，尤其是对私人消费的影响，并不那么强烈。我研究了政府支出的各种私人债务依赖的传导渠道，包括劳动力市场和金融市场。劳动力市场行为和企业债务积压与家庭债务积压之间投资决策的差异，可能对理解实证结果很重要。

articles.title_en: Expectation dispersion, uncertainty, and the reaction to news
articles.title_cn: 预期分散、不确定性与对新闻的反应
articles.abstract_en: Key macroeconomic indicator releases are closely monitored by financial markets. We examine the impact of expectation dispersion and economic uncertainty on the stock market’s reaction to these indicators. We find that the strength of the financial market response to news decreases with the preceding dispersion in expectations about the indicator value. Higher uncertainty, in contrast, increases the response. We rationalize our findings in a model of imperfect information. In the model, dispersion results from a perceived weak link between macroeconomic indicators and fundamentals that reduces the informational content of indicators, while fundamental uncertainty makes their informational content more valuable.
articles.abstract_cn: 关键宏观经济指标的发布受到金融市场的密切关注。我们研究了预期分散和经济不确定性对股市对这些指标反应的影响。我们发现，金融市场对新闻的反应强度随着先前关于指标值的预期分散程度的增加而减弱。相比之下，更高的不确定性则增强了反应。我们在一个不完全信息模型中合理化我们的发现。在该模型中，分散源于感知到的宏观经济指标与基本面之间的薄弱联系，这降低了指标的信息含量，而基本面不确定性则使其信息含量更有价值。

articles.title_en: The macroeconomic effects of uncertainty and risk aversion shocks
articles.title_cn: 不确定性与风险厌恶冲击的宏观经济效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper identifies two types of volatility shocks, namely quantity and price of risk shocks, which can intuitively be interpreted as uncertainty and risk aversion shocks, respectively. Identification is achieved in a shock-restricted SVAR framework using a combination of narrative and external variable restrictions. We find that uncertainty shocks have large negative effects on output, while risk aversion shocks are particularly damaging to asset prices and are deflationary. We also quantify to which extent the endogenous response of risk aversion can exacerbate the effects of uncertainty shocks, thereby providing an estimate of the quantitative relevance of the risk-premium channel of uncertainty shocks. A historical contribution exercise suggests that the GFC is best characterised by a combination of uncertainty and risk aversion shocks, while uncertainty shocks were more important than risk aversion shocks during the COVID pandemic.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文识别了两种类型的波动性冲击，即风险的数量和价格冲击，它们可以直观地分别解释为不确定性和风险厌恶冲击。识别是在一个冲击受限的SVAR框架中，结合叙事和外部变量限制实现的。我们发现不确定性冲击对产出有较大的负面影响，而风险厌恶冲击对资产价格尤其有害且具有通缩效应。我们还量化了风险厌恶的内生反应在多大程度上可以加剧不确定性冲击的影响，从而提供了不确定性冲击风险溢价渠道的定量相关性估计。历史贡献分解表明，全球金融危机最好被描述为不确定性和风险厌恶冲击的组合，而在新冠疫情期间，不确定性冲击比风险厌恶冲击更为重要。

articles.title_en: Will the last be the first? School closures and educational outcomes
articles.title_cn: 最后会成为第一吗？学校关闭与教育成果
articles.abstract_en: Governments have implemented school closures and online learning as one of the main tools to reduce the spread of Covid-19. Despite the potential benefits in terms of containment of virus diffusion, the educational costs of these policies may be dramatic. This work identifies these costs, expressed as decrease in test scores, for the whole universe of Italian students attending the 5th, 8th and 13th grade of the school cycle during the 2021/22 school year. The analysis is based on a difference-in-difference model in relative time, where the control group is the closest generation before the Covid-19 pandemic. Results suggest a national average loss between 1.8–4.0% in Mathematics and Italian test scores. After collecting the precise number of school closure days for the universe of students in Sicily, this work also estimates that the average days of closure decrease the test score by 2.4%. In this context, parents appear to have a partial compensatory effect, but only when holding higher levels of education and when their children are attending low and middle schools. This is likely explained by the lower relevance of parental inputs and higher reliance on other inputs, such as peers, for the higher grades. Finally, the effects are also heterogeneous across class size, parents’ country of birth and job conditions, pointing towards potential growing inequalities driven by the lack of frontal teaching.
articles.abstract_cn: 政府已将学校关闭和在线学习作为减少Covid-19传播的主要工具之一。尽管在遏制病毒传播方面具有潜在益处，但这些政策的教育成本可能是巨大的。本研究针对2021/22学年意大利学校周期中5、8和13年级的所有学生，识别了这些成本，表现为考试成绩的下降。分析基于相对时间的双重差分模型，其中对照组是Covid-19大流行前最近的一代。结果表明，数学和意大利语考试成绩的全国平均损失在1.8-4.0%之间。在收集了西西里岛所有学生学校关闭天数的精确数据后，本研究还估计，平均关闭天数使考试成绩下降2.4%。在此背景下，父母似乎具有部分补偿效应，但仅在父母受教育程度较高且其子女就读于小学和初中时。这很可能是因为在较高年级，父母投入的相关性较低，而更多依赖同伴等其他投入。最后，这些效应在班级规模、父母出生国和工作条件方面也存在异质性，表明缺乏面对面教学可能导致日益加剧的不平等。
